verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official CLI, `wmill`, for working with instances from the terminal. It also supports CLI deployments from a Git repository and Git sync that auto-deploys new commits, so it can clearly be driven headlessly. However, no evidence shows an explicit CI pipeline integration or a non-interactive CI runbook, so CI use is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples or non-interactive auth in CI), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Windmill CLI, `wmill` allows you to interact with Windmill instances right from your terminal.
as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
Windmill can automatically deploy new commits from the repository into the workspace
